result.title: Helgason-Fourier Random Features for Scalable Hyperbolic Latent Variables
result.summary: Hyperbolic geometry is well suited to embedding hierarchical data, capturing tree-like structure faithfully even in the low dimensions where Euclidean dimensionality reduction is severely constrained. We introduce Random Helgason--Fourier Features (RHFF), an explicit finite-dimensional feature map for kernels on hyperbolic space. We characterize the spectral density from which RHFF frequencies are drawn, allowing kernels such as the Matérn family to be specified directly in the frequency domain. We also prove a uniform approximation error bound for RHFF. Building on this representation, we develop a hyperbolic latent variable model called RHFF-LVM, which requires no numerical quadrature, variational bounds or auxiliary variables unlike previous hyperbolic GP-LVMs. Our RHFF-LVM recovers the metric of a synthetic tree more faithfully than all baselines and attains the best mean rank, driven by large gains on tree-structured atlases at $Q\!=\!2$. Furthermore, it fits $5\times10^{5}$ points in $505$ seconds, making it the first non-parametric hyperbolic LVM to reach this scale.

AI.brief_summary: 提出双曲空间核的显式有限维特征映射 RHFF，刻画其谱密度并给出均匀逼近误差界，据此构建无需数值积分或变分界的双曲潜变量模型 RHFF-LVM，在合成树结构与大规模数据上取得更好拟合与可扩展性。
AI.relevance_reason: 双曲潜变量与显式特征映射的表示几何，可供核查 LVR 中保留层级结构的低维潜状态与表示容量问题；但论文不涉及多模态推理或状态更新，联系属于概念层面。
